description: This Java class 'AccountEnumerations' provides static methods to map account types (represented by AccountType enum) to EnumOptionData objects, specifically for loan types within the account details service of the Fineract project.

classes.name: AccountEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class that provides methods to convert AccountType enums into EnumOptionData objects for different loan types.

methods.name: loanType(final Integer loanTypeId)
methods.description: Converts an integer loan type ID to an EnumOptionData object.

methods.name: loanType(final String name)
methods.description: Converts a string name to an EnumOptionData object by mapping it to an AccountType enum.

methods.name: loanType(final AccountType type)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData representing the given AccountType enumeration value.
